headline: Superpowers Turns Agent Discipline Into Practice
lede: At 321,648 stars, Superpowers is becoming a visible marker of the coding-agent moment. Its structured workflow moves from requirements discovery to tested, reviewable implementation instead of treating code generation as the finish line.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Agents a Universal Handle
lede: CLI-Anything puts a command-line surface in front of software that was never designed for autonomous operation. Its tested harnesses let agents discover and control tools such as Blender, Kdenlive, Obsidian, and Zotero through predictable commands.

headline: MiniMind Teaches Language Models From Scratch
lede: MiniMind compresses the language-model curriculum into a project that can train on a consumer GPU. Native PyTorch implementations cover pretraining, fine-tuning, preference optimization, distillation, tool use, and serving, making each stage inspectable rather than opaque.

headline: Cursor Plugins Turn Workflows Into Capabilities
lede: Cursor’s plugin repository treats agent behavior as an installable engineering surface. Each manifest packages skills, integrations, and repeatable workflows, extending one coding environment into a registry that reaches across development, operations, sales, recruiting, and knowledge work.

headline: Firecrawl Brings the Live Web Into Reach
lede: Firecrawl turns dynamic pages, documents, and browser actions into structured material for agents and retrieval systems. Rendering, crawling, proxy rotation, rate limits, and asynchronous jobs are joined behind interfaces that deliver Markdown, JSON, HTML, or screenshots.

headline: NGINX Keeps Traffic Moving at the Edge
lede: NGINX remains the dependable layer between users and the services behind them. Its worker architecture, caching, TLS termination, proxying, load balancing, and modular configuration give production teams a compact instrument for moving traffic with control.

headline: OpenVINO Strips Inference Down to Hardware
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training ecosystems into an optimized representation for deployment. CPU, GPU, and NPU backends, quantization tools, and serving APIs target the hard constraint beneath every application: useful inference with less latency and memory.

headline: Diagram Design Makes Structure Ready to Share
lede: Diagram Design turns a plain-language brief into a polished, standalone HTML and SVG artifact. Across 44 diagram types, it applies grids, brand palettes, and layout checks so architecture maps, timelines, and flows arrive ready for the browser rather than trapped in a renderer.

headline: Last30days Builds Evidence From the Present
lede: The last30days skill assembles a recent-world dossier from forums, video, markets, news, code, and research. Parallel searches and attributable evidence give agents a method for separating current signal from the static residue of ordinary search.

headline: Stitch Skills Connect Design to Working Code
lede: Stitch Skills lays out a practical route from visual concept to production interface. Its agent workflows generate designs, extract systems, manage assets, and translate screens into React, React Native, Vite, shadcn/ui, or Remotion projects.
